name: feedback
description: A two-sided loop for improving agent plugins from test sessions. The 'session' skill (tester side) turns the current session record into a copy-pasteable report grading the plugins exercised; the 'jot' skill files a quick note or idea about a single surface mid-session; the 'triage' skill (author side) aggregates many reports and jots into a prioritized action plan, routing each finding to a concrete fix. All three share one report-format contract.

jot_dir.title: Jot folder
jot_dir.description: Absolute path of the folder jot files are written to on this machine; unset writes to .docs/feedback/jots/ in the current repo
